# Rice and Protein

> A free TDEE calculator and practical weight loss guide. No keto, no supplements, no starving. Just calories in vs calories out, done sustainably.

## What this site is

Rice and Protein is a weight loss resource built around one principle: calorie balance. The site provides a free TDEE (Total Daily Energy Expenditure) calculator, a protein target guide, and practical diet guides for common approaches including CICO, volume eating, intermittent fasting, keto, paleo, and OMAD.

The core philosophy: you can eat filling, satisfying food and still lose fat. Volume eating — building meals from high-volume, low-calorie-density foods like rice, chicken breast, and vegetables — is the main method advocated here.

## Key tools

- **TDEE Calculator** (homepage): Calculates maintenance calories using three formulas (Mifflin-St Jeor, Harris-Benedict, Schofield), averages them, then applies a user-selected deficit or surplus to give a daily calorie target.
- **Protein Target**: Calculated from goal weight x 1.6g to 2.2g per kg.
- **Goal selector**: Cut (fat loss) or Bulk (muscle gain), with adjustable deficit/surplus percentage.
